newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HUNTER DOUGLAS UPBEAT ON 1997 PROSPECTS.
newsitem.headline: HUNTER DOUGLAS UPBEAT ON 1997 PROSPECTS.

text.p: Window coverings maker Hunter Douglas NV said on Tuesday it was optimistic for 1997.

"With Hunter Douglas' business performing strongly in North America, Asia and Latin America, and an expected pick-up in its European and Australian business, Hunter Douglas remains optimistic for 1997 and its future prospects," it said.

Earlier, the company posted 1996 net profit of 158.3 million guilders, up from 125.6 million in 1995. In August, Hunter Douglas said it was optimistic about the second half of 1996 after first-half profits rose by 24.8 percent.
